problems: Cliopatria 'New Caledonia' 1856-1859 is a French overseas aggregate (bbox 55 E to 168 E, 22 S to 23 N, India/France then Vietnam), not New Caledonia: both shapes verdict wrong, island group rebuilt from 1853; the aggregate may duplicate french-india or french-indochina rows (France authors should check).

Cliopatria 'Papua New Guinea' 1946-1975 is the Territory of Papua and New Guinea under Australia; verdict wrong as a state (it begins 16 September 1975) and its land is carried by commonwealth-of-australia (keyframes 1906, 1920, 1946). If the project prefers it drawn as a type colony under its own name, reverse that verdict and drop the Australian holding. The PNG 1946 shape also misses 91 cells of the modern country and Australia's 1946 shape keeps 34 of them (29 on Bougainville) to 2023.

Cliopatria Commonwealth of Australia 1943-1945 shapes draw Allied-held New Guinea, with 8, 50 and 292 cells in Indonesian (then Dutch) western New Guinea; corrected to the whole PNG as Australian land with Japanese-held land as contest events.

New Zealand is written as the Dominion/Realm from 26 September 1907; the Colony of New Zealand 1841-1907 (and the New Zealand Wars) is left to colony-of-new-zealand (oc-02-x, already named by oc-01). Cliopatria has no row before 1948.
Vanuatu's Cliopatria row begins 1983 while the New Hebrides ended 30 July 1980; this dossier cuts the 1979 shape at July 1980, leaving 1981-1982 to oc-02-b's vanuatu.
Counterpart slugs guessed by slugify and awaiting dossiers: the six colony-of-* slugs, british-new-guinea, german-new-guinea, german-samoa, samoa, cook-islands, niue (validator warns only).
The grid has no Antarctic land cells: the Australian Antarctic Territory (1936) and Ross Dependency (1923) events resolve to nothing.
